title: meta
Confirm which passports Brandon actually holds

extras.note: Photograph the data page of every passport plus any citizenship certificate. Everything below branches on this.

title: Verify citizenship by descent is registered

extras.note: Born overseas to an Australian parent makes you eligible, not automatically a citizen. No certificate means no passport means no boarding pass.

title: Lodge citizenship by descent if unregistered

extras.note: Form 118 via ImmiAccount, AUD $380. Assume 4-6 months. If this is needed, replan the January date now rather than in December.

title: Book the consulate passport appointment

extras.note: First-time adult applicants cannot apply by mail. Houston is the nearest post. Appointment slots, not processing, are usually the binding constraint.

title: Assemble the PC8 document pack

extras.note: Citizenship certificate, US birth certificate, photo ID, two compliant photos, and a guarantor. The guarantor is the most common cause of a wasted appointment.

title: Lodge the Australian passport application

extras.note: Allow 8-12 weeks. Working back from mid-January at 12 weeks gives 22 Oct, so build in two weeks of slack before booking flights.

title: Budget the passport fee before January indexation

extras.note: About USD $445 all in. Fees index every 1 January, so lodging in October avoids the 2027 rise.

title: Renew an expiring Australian passport by mail

extras.note: If he already holds one, renewal uses the one-page PC7 by mail. No interview, no guarantor. New passport gets a new number.

title: Check and renew the US passport if needed

extras.note: US citizens must enter and leave the US on a US passport, so both must be valid on departure day. Routine 4-6 weeks plus mailing.

title: Go / no-go on the passport

extras.note: Decision point. Passport in hand? If not, the emergency-passport route is about 2 business days but limited validity, and January needs replanning.

title: Write down the two-passport departure sequence

extras.note: Leave the US on the US passport, enter Australia on the Australian one. Present the Australian passport at check-in or the airline's border check fails. Never apply for a visa on the US passport as a workaround.

title: Settle it: school leaver or university entrant

extras.note: One call to TISC on 08 9318 8000 decides which of two entirely different plans applies. The complication is the qualification, not the citizenship.

title: Check the course-specific early deadlines

extras.note: Medicine and Dentistry closed 30 Sep 2026. Physiotherapy closes 30 Nov. Murdoch Vet Science has already gone for 2027.

title: Check the SAT/ACT within-two-years-of-diploma rule

extras.note: UWA requires the test to have been sat within two years of the diploma. Fail it and the conversion table does not apply, pushing him to alternative entry.

title: Register for a TISCOnline User ID

extras.note: No WA student number means he must register to be issued an 8-digit User ID before he can apply. Do not assume it is instant.

title: Create a Unique Student Identifier

extras.note: Required to apply and enrol. Verified against an Australian identity document, so this depends on the passport or citizenship certificate.

title: Order official US high school transcripts

extras.note: The hard blocker. TISC wants colour scans of originals, photocopies are rejected. US schools take 2-6 weeks and shut over Thanksgiving and Christmas.

title: Order US college transcripts if he has credit

extras.note: Same deadline, and also the basis for any advanced standing or credit transfer, which the university assesses separately and later.

title: Order official SAT/ACT score reports

extras.note: UWA converts directly: ACT 25 = ATAR 85, SAT 1220 = ATAR 85. ATAR 70 is the minimum entry at most WA universities.

title: Satisfy the English competency requirement

extras.note: Separate from the ATAR equivalent. UWA accepts ACT English 25 or SAT English 600. The WACE route does not apply to him.

title: Verify no apostille is needed before paying for one

extras.note: For a domestic WA application there is no apostille requirement. TISC wants colour scans of originals. Confirm with each university before spending money.

title: Consider sitting the STAT as an ATAR substitute

extras.note: Skills for Tertiary Admissions Test, $225 one section. The November 2026 sittings on 20 and 28 Nov are the last useful ones for Semester 1.

title: Gather AP results if held

extras.note: AP scores of 3+ can supplement the diploma, but UWA lists no AP equivalents for prerequisites, so do not count on AP to clear a maths or chemistry prerequisite.

title: Explore Experience Based Entry as the fallback

extras.note: The route when the qualification alone falls short. Branded StepUp at Curtin, ECU Access, Broadway at UWA. ECU's round closes 27 Nov 2026.

title: Line up an enabling course as the safety net

extras.note: Curtin UniReady, ECU UniPrep, Murdoch OnTrack, all available through TISC. Uni Ready courses are fee-free on a Commonwealth supported place.

title: Submit the TISC application and pay the $95

extras.note: Applications are not considered until the fee is paid. Preferences can be rearranged free until close, so apply early and tune later.

title: Apply for the Education Access Scheme

extras.note: Main round closes 27 Nov 2026, 5pm.

title: Upload every document to TISC

extras.note: Hard deadline, 11:59pm. Colour originals, PDF/JPEG/PNG under 5MB. TISC only attempts electronic retrieval of overseas results, so assume he uploads everything himself.

title: Close out TISC preferences

extras.note: Apply and preference close 11:59pm. Main round offers land 24 Dec 2026.

title: Work the second round if the main round misses

extras.note: Apply and documents close 13 Jan 2027, 11:59pm, for offers on 20 Jan, right as he lands.

title: Keep the direct-to-university late window in reserve

extras.note: After TISC closes, Curtin takes direct applications to 28 Jan 2027 and ECU to 7 Feb. Most people do not realise this window exists.

title: Confirm the HECS-HELP in-Australia rule

extras.note: Citizenship alone is not enough. He must undertake at least one unit physically in Australia, so starting a WA degree online from Texas risks losing HECS-HELP for that unit.

title: Submit the HECS-HELP form before census date

extras.note: The item that most often costs real money. Miss the census date and he owes the full up-front fee with no loan.

title: Budget against the student contribution bands

extras.note: 2026 maximums per year: Law and Commerce $17,399; Engineering, Science and Computing $9,537; Education, Nursing and Maths $4,738. 2027 rates publish late this year.

title: Decide school versus university by early October

extras.note: WA Term 1 2027 runs 1 Feb to 9 Apr. A mid-January arrival leaves roughly two weeks.

title: Get SCSA advice in writing on WACE and ATAR

extras.note: Arriving from a US high school in January means none of the 20 required WA units are banked, and OLNA sittings are scheduled. Settle whether a WACE or ATAR is achievable before enrolling, not in March.

title: Check the local-intake area on Schools Online

extras.note: WA public schools set a catchment boundary and inside it gets priority when oversubscribed. Check the family's Perth address before assuming a school.

title: Approach private schools early

extras.note: Perth independent and Catholic schools run their own waitlists and interviews, separate from the public system. Year 11 and 12 entry is the hardest to place.

title: Apply to one public school and await the outcome

extras.note: The process is apply, wait for the outcome, then accept. Applying to several at once is not how it works.

title: Assemble the enrolment document pack

extras.note: Needs an AIR immunisation statement dated within the last 2 months, proof of address, and evidence of citizenship.

title: Collect complete US vaccination records

extras.note: The sleeper blocker. Only an Australian provider can add overseas immunisations to the register, and they must be in English. Gaps may need catch-up doses spaced weeks apart.

title: Do a full US medical, dental and optical clearance

extras.note: Cheapest while still on US insurance, and it produces the records an Australian GP will want. Deal with wisdom teeth, braces and glasses in Texas.

title: Assemble Medicare proof-of-residency evidence

extras.note: Needs the current passport plus two documents dated within the last 6 months proving he lives in Australia. Living with family means no lease in his name, so line up an enrolment or employment letter instead.

title: Buy gap health cover for the arrival window

extras.note: No Medicare waiting period applies to a citizen, but there is a real gap between landing and enrolment processing, and the US has no reciprocal health agreement with Australia.

title: Carry a prescription letter and original packaging

extras.note: Keep medicines labelled, carry a doctor's letter using generic names, and declare them on arrival. Several routine US prescriptions are controlled or unavailable in Australia.

title: Enrol in Medicare in week one

extras.note: Cannot be done before arrival. Complete form MS004 and mail or email it with documents. Documents do not need to be certified.

title: Use the digital Medicare card from day one

extras.note: The plastic card takes 3-4 weeks but the digital card works as soon as you enrol, through the Express Plus Medicare app.

title: Book a GP to load records onto the register

extras.note: Only a recognised Australian provider can enter overseas immunisations. With a 1 Feb school start that is two weeks of runway plus possible catch-up doses.

title: Bridge any mental health continuity

extras.note: Relocation at this age is a known risk window, and university counselling has queues in first semester. Arrange a bridge with the US provider before he goes.

title: Open the Australian bank account before flying

extras.note: CommBank allows opening up to 14 days before arrival. Account details come immediately but you cannot deposit until identified in branch, and earlier transfers get reversed.

title: Diarise the in-branch ID deadline

extras.note: Provide ID at a branch within 20 days of opening or the account closes automatically. Bring the original passport and the US tax identification number.

title: Move money with an FX specialist, not a bank wire

extras.note: The ACCC found consumers moving AUD $10,000 could save over $400 by using the cheapest provider. The cost hides in the exchange rate margin, not the fee line.

title: Keep one US bank account and card open

extras.note: Needed for any IRS refund, residual direct debits, and as a fallback if Australian card issuance lags. Update it to an address that still receives mail.

title: Set up myID to Strong identity strength

extras.note: The hidden payoff of the Australian passport. Strong needs an Australian passport plus one other Australian document. A US passport alone will not get there.

title: Apply for the Tax File Number in week one

extras.note: With Strong myID it is usually issued immediately. Without a TFN an employer withholds at the top marginal rate, recoverable only at tax time.

title: Set up myGov and get a Centrelink CRN

extras.note: Do it the same week as Medicare and the TFN so the identity stack is built once. A study claim can usually be lodged about 13 weeks before the course starts.

title: Know the newly arrived waiting period does not apply

extras.note: The most misunderstood item in the move. The 208-week wait attaches to visa holders. An Australian citizen holds no visa. Do not let anyone talk him into waiting four years.

title: Check Youth Allowance or Austudy if studying

extras.note: Qualification turns on being resident and physically in Australia, not a waiting period. The real obstacles are the parental income test and proving independence.

title: Choose a super fund before the first payday

extras.note: Use the ATO YourSuper tool, then give the employer a standard choice form. Nominate nothing and it goes to the employer default. Super Guarantee is 12%.

title: Start a travel-day log on 1 January

extras.note: The Foreign Earned Income Exclusion needs 330 full days abroad in a 12-month period. A mid-January arrival makes that workable only if he avoids long US trips.

title: Engage a US-Australia cross-border tax adviser once

extras.note: Superannuation is the sharp edge. Employer contributions are not deductible on a US return and the treaty has no super article. One paid hour beats an amended-return project.

title: File the 2026 US Form 1040 as normal

extras.note: Calendar 2026 is a full US-resident year with Texas wages. Nothing about the move changes it.

title: Keep filing a US 1040 every year from Australia

extras.note: US citizenship-based taxation means worldwide income is reportable wherever he lives. Living abroad gives an automatic extension to 15 June.

title: Track balances for the FBAR and assume super counts

extras.note: FinCEN 114 triggers on the aggregate of all foreign accounts exceeding $10,000 at any point. Practitioner consensus is that superannuation is reportable. Start recording peak balances now.

title: Expect a reduced part-year tax-free threshold

extras.note: Newcomers get a pro-rated threshold, roughly $15,832 for a mid-January arrival, not the full $18,200. People budget on the wrong number and get a smaller refund.

title: Verify the USA on the DoT recognised-country checker

extras.note: Two minutes online, and it decides whether the transfer is one appointment or two tests. The USA appears on the national Austroads list, but confirm on the WA checker before flying.

title: Assemble the five WA proof-of-identity documents

extras.note: Category A is an Australian birth certificate or citizenship document. A returning citizen with only a US passport has no Category A document, and ordering one takes weeks.

title: Order a certified Texas driving record

extras.note: $10 for a Type 3A, immediate online. Australian insurers default a new arrival to the worst band, and this is the evidence that buys a discount. Far harder to get once he has no Texas address.

title: Get a no-claims letter from the US insurer

extras.note: Distinct from the DPS record and equally valuable. Nearly impossible to obtain after the policy lapses.

title: Decide on an International Driving Permit

extras.note: An IDP is a translation, not a licence, and WA only needs one if the licence is not in English. Worth it only if he drives in a non-English-speaking country en route.

title: Book the WA licence transfer appointment

extras.note: Metro service centres are busy with the January and February rush. Call 13 11 56 rather than assume walk-in.

title: Transfer the Texas licence within 3 months

extras.note: After 3 months of residence, driving on the Texas licence is illegal even though it is current and valid. The clock starts on arrival.

title: Get a Tertiary SmartRider and register the concession

extras.note: About $5-10 on campus. Register through the university portal, then tag on for four rides within 7 days or the concession never activates.

title: Get sea freight quotes this week

extras.note: Door-to-door US to Australia runs 10-18 weeks from the packing date, so a shipment collected after mid-October will not be in Perth for a January arrival.

title: Book the freight collection

extras.note: The hardest already-live deadline after the passport. Miss it and belongings land in February or March.

title: Complete the unaccompanied personal effects form

extras.note: Goods owned and used for 12+ months generally enter duty and GST free, but the B534 declaration must be accurate. People leave it to the forwarder then cannot answer questions.

title: Biosecurity-proof the shipment before packing

extras.note: Scrub shoes, sports gear and tools free of soil and seeds. No part-opened food or seeds. Contaminated cartons trigger fumigation and unpack fees. Pack risk items in separately marked boxes.

title: Do not ship 110V appliances

extras.note: Australia is 230-240V with Type I plugs. US kitchen appliances, hair tools and anything with a motor will not work properly on a transformer. Sell them.

title: Price excess baggage against a shipment

extras.note: For one person's belongings, two or three extra checked bags often beats a shared-container quote and arrives the same day he does.

title: Digitise every important document

extras.note: Birth certificate, SSN card, transcripts, immunisation records, prescriptions, tax returns. Encrypted cloud copies plus certified originals in the carry-on, never the hold.

title: Keep the US mobile number alive for 2FA

extras.note: The most-forgotten item on the list. US banks, the IRS and brokerages SMS codes to a US number. Port it to a cheap prepaid or Google Voice BEFORE cancelling the carrier.

title: Migrate authenticator apps and print recovery codes

extras.note: Export the codes before the phone or number changes. Account recovery from overseas with a foreign IP is brutal.

title: Set up US mail forwarding or a digital mailbox

extras.note: USPS forwarding is 12 months maximum and does not forward everything. A scanning service preserves a usable US address for banks and the IRS.

title: Tell US banks and cards he is moving

extras.note: Many US institutions close or restrict accounts on a foreign address. Use a family address rather than an Australian one.

title: Keep the SSN card and update the SSA

extras.note: Replacing a lost SSN card from overseas is slow, and the number is needed for every future US tax and financial step.

title: Sort US student loans before departure

extras.note: Foreign addresses break servicer communications, and income-driven repayment recalculations on Australian income need proactive filing.

title: Get an Australian prepaid SIM on arrival

extras.note: Prepaid needs no Australian credit history and activates on a passport. Postpaid needs a credit file he will not have for 6-12 months.

title: File IRS Form 8822 change of address

extras.note: Cheap insurance that IRS notices reach him. Missed notices become penalties.

title: Enrol in STEP with the US Consulate

extras.note: Free, two minutes, and puts him on the consulate's list for emergencies. Perth has a US Consulate General.

title: Cancel US subscriptions on the right dates

extras.note: Cancel US health insurance after departure, not before, and keep auto insurance until the car sells. Cancelling early creates a coverage gap that inflates future premiums.

title: Book flights to Perth

extras.note: January is peak Australian summer traffic and Perth is a long-haul spur. Allow a generous domestic connection since bags are rechecked in the first Australian port.

title: Confirm baggage allowance on both legs

extras.note: Allowances differ between the US and Australian domestic legs of the same ticket, and excess at the gate is punitive.

title: Agree a standing family call slot

extras.note: Perth is UTC+8 with no daylight saving, 13-15 hours ahead of Texas, so there is almost no overlapping waking time on weekdays. Agree it before he leaves.

title: Complete the Incoming Passenger Card honestly

extras.note: Still the legal declaration. Declare all food, plant and animal products, wooden items, medicines and cash over AUD $10,000. Declaring costs nothing.

title: Eat or bin the snacks before landing

extras.note: Jerky, fruit, seeds, nuts and honey are the classic accidental fine. Forgetting it was in the bag is not a defence.

title: Plan the airport transfer in advance

extras.note: Perth long-haul arrivals skew to very early morning, and rideshare with several suitcases needs a larger vehicle booked ahead.

title: Run the week-one sequence in the right order

extras.note: Bank branch ID, Medicare, myID, TFN, SIM, GP, SmartRider. Doing these out of order (licence before bank, bank before address) wastes days.

title: Enrol to vote once eligible

extras.note: Compulsory for citizens 18+. Eligible after one month at the address, then 21 days to enrol. Needs an Australian licence, passport, Medicare or citizenship number, not a US passport.

title: Build a Perth support network deliberately

extras.note: StudyPerth events, university international services, US expat groups. The failure mode at this age is a quiet first six weeks, not a paperwork error.
